entries.reachability_signal: dnsmasq log shows non-QUERY request received, response sent with RCODE
entries.expected_signal: Before: non-QUERY request enters forwarding path (tcp_talk or forwarding log). After: non-QUERY request gets RCODE rejection (no forwarding)
entries.input_strategy: DNS NOTIFY (opcode=4) request over TCP targeting example.com SOA
entries.limitations: Requires loopback network access. Binds to TCP ports 10601-10602. Must run as non-root. dnsmasq is started/stopped per test. Network namespace isolation preferred but not available in this environment.
